result:
I would make empathy unavoidable.

Not as a moral ideal to pursue, but as a sensory reality. I would bridge the gap between one person’s action and another’s experience so that cause and effect are felt simultaneously. If harm were inflicted, the harm would be felt by the inflictor. If joy were shared, the joy would be doubled in the sharer.

Conflict exists because of the distance between self and other. Remove that distance, and the cost of cruelty becomes immediate to the perpetrator. Peace wouldn’t need to be mandated; it would simply become the most comfortable state of being.
